_readme: 時間軸資料。lane：edu（學習）、work（工作）、train（進修）。只有 start 沒有 end 的會畫成一個點；end 填 "now" 代表進行中。period 是畫面上顯示的文字。色塊上的短標籤取 title 裡「｜」前面的字，或另外填 label。

title.zh: 東海大學｜資訊管理學士

note.zh: 從馬來西亞來台求學，以資訊管理為主，修過一學期工業設計。
note.en: Came from Malaysia to study in Taiwan; majored in information management and took a semester of industrial design.

note.en: Moved from information systems into design, working on users, interfaces and experience.

title.zh: 威盛電子｜高級產品行銷代表
title.en: VIA Technologies — Senior Product Marketing Representative

note.zh: 設計 4 份標準化 RMA 服務文件；製作技術引導與應用場景影片；把硬體規格整理成智慧城市應用場景提案與空間配置圖。
note.en: Designed 4 standardized RMA service documents; produced technical how-to and use-case videos; turned hardware specs into smart city scenario proposals and space plans.

title.zh: 威盛電子｜高級行銷代表

note.zh: 參與 21+ 支影音資產全流程產出（含 Minexpo 2024）；開發 10 份標準化安裝指南與影片 SOP，FAE 現場支援需求減少約三成；規劃企業與子公司網站介面，資訊三次點擊內取得。
note.en: Took part in end-to-end production of 21+ video assets (incl. Minexpo 2024); developed 10 standardized installation guides and video SOPs, cutting on-site FAE support requests by about 30%; planned UI for the corporate and subsidiary websites, with key information within three clicks.
